relations.rationale: Cleo and Yara being on different teams implies there are at least two teams, which is consistent with but does not confirm exactly three teams.
Vik's age relative to Dara has no bearing on which teams Dara and Yara are on.
Vik setting up watering equipment in the morning is unrelated to the volunteers sharing coffee and pastries.
The break around ten is the likely occasion during which the coffee and pastries were shared, so it supports that claim.
A short break around ten does not directly imply or negate the midmorning buzz of activity described separately.
The break described in claim 21 could correspond to the pause described in claim 26, suggesting a similar event, supporting its occurrence.
Dara and Yara being on different teams implies at least two teams exist, which is compatible with but doesn't confirm three teams specifically.
The description of midmorning activity and progress supports the later claim that the group paused to admire the progress made.
